title: Figure 1: Map of observation site near Tremonton, Utah – "Utah" film analysis
description: Printed regional road map of northern Utah and southeastern Idaho, from Pocatello south to Salt Lake City, including the Great Salt Lake, Ogden, Logan and Brigham City. A pasted label marks "Observation" with an X near Tremonton, northwest of Brigham City. The page header reads "Photogrammetric Analysis of 'Utah' Film -7- Serial 02," and a compass rose and the caption "FIGURE 1" are included.
